ImportEdgeRecord.description:
An edge row. Each end is found the way a node row is — by an entity id, a pointer
(``sourceUrn``, or ``source.<identifier property>``), a field matched by "Match imports by
this" (``source.<field>``), or a qualifiedName — and the edge by its two ends and its type.

_op.description: Blank or `upsert` creates or updates; `delete` deletes the entity the row names.
_op.title: Op

baseVersion.description: The entity's content hash, as an export writes it. If the entity has changed since, only the cells you changed apply, and a row whose cell someone else also changed is refused, naming it. Leave it out to set what the row carries.
baseVersion.title: Baseversion

edgeType.description: The edge's type, one of the data source's relationship types.
edgeType.title: Edgetype

entity_id.description: The node or edge's own id, as an export writes it: a row with one updates that entity. Any other value is the file's own id for the row — it links the file's rows to each other (an edge to a node) and nothing more.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

properties_json.description: Properties too nested for a column, as a JSON object. A `null` value removes the property.
properties_json.title: Properties Json

sourceQualifiedName.description: The source node's qualifiedName, for an end named by nothing else.
sourceQualifiedName.title: Sourcequalifiedname

sourceUrn.description: The source node's urn. A pointer, not stored: it finds the node that carries it as its urn, or the node an earlier import made from it — whose id is derived from it, so importing the same file again updates what it made. A `urn:uuid:` no node holds is kept as the new node's id. To see your own id on the node, keep it in a property marked "Match imports by this" too.
sourceUrn.title: Sourceurn

source_entity_id.description: The source node's entity id, or the file's own id of a node row.
source_entity_id.title: Source Entity Id

targetQualifiedName.description: The target node's qualifiedName, for an end named by nothing else.
targetQualifiedName.title: Targetqualifiedname

targetUrn.description: The target node's urn. A pointer, not stored: it finds the node that carries it as its urn, or the node an earlier import made from it — whose id is derived from it, so importing the same file again updates what it made. A `urn:uuid:` no node holds is kept as the new node's id. To see your own id on the node, keep it in a property marked "Match imports by this" too.
targetUrn.title: Targeturn

target_entity_id.description: The target node's entity id, or the file's own id of a node row.
target_entity_id.title: Target Entity Id

ImportEdgeRecord.title: ImportEdgeRecord

ImportNodeRecord.description:
A node row. ``prop.<name>`` columns set its properties: a value sets one, a blank cell
leaves it as it is, and ``\N`` removes it.

_op.description: Blank or `upsert` creates or updates; `delete` deletes the entity the row names.
_op.title: Op

baseVersion.description: The entity's content hash, as an export writes it. If the entity has changed since, only the cells you changed apply, and a row whose cell someone else also changed is refused, naming it. Leave it out to set what the row carries.
baseVersion.title: Baseversion

entityType.description: The node's type, one of the data source's entity types. Required for a new node.
entityType.title: Entitytype

entity_id.description: The node or edge's own id, as an export writes it: a row with one updates that entity. Any other value is the file's own id for the row — it links the file's rows to each other (an edge to a node) and nothing more.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

layerAssignment.description: The layer of the view an import into a view places a new node in.
layerAssignment.title: Layerassignment

properties_json.description: Properties too nested for a column, as a JSON object. A `null` value removes the property.
properties_json.title: Properties Json

qualifiedName.description: A dotted path naming the node. A row with no urn and no identifier value finds the node by it, if exactly one node carries it.
qualifiedName.title: Qualifiedname

tags.description: Tags: a list, or one comma-separated text.
tags.title: Tags

urn.description: The node's urn. A pointer, not stored: it finds the node that carries it as its urn, or the node an earlier import made from it — whose id is derived from it, so importing the same file again updates what it made. A `urn:uuid:` no node holds is kept as the new node's id. To see your own id on the node, keep it in a property marked "Match imports by this" too.
urn.title: Urn

ImportNodeRecord.title: ImportNodeRecord

description: One node or edge of an import or export file: a CSV/TSV/XLSX row (every cell text), an NDJSON line or a JSON object. Imported with POST …/versioning/graphs/{graphId}/imports; checked without writing with POST …/imports/validate. Version 1 only gains columns. See docs/CONNECTOR_GUIDE.md.
title: Import record v1
